features.quote: The model emits a clear refusal to continue (e.g., "I give up," "I cannot proceed").
The model produces no tool calls for 2 consecutive turns (stall).
The model attempts to access restricted files outside the workspace (security stop).
Repeated failure can trigger policy-violating outputs in rare cases (e.g., aggressive self-deprecation). Run an output moderation filter in parallel and flag runs for human review if triggered.
